name: Perplexity Comet Competitor Analysis Agent
headline: Perplexity Comet Competitor Analysis Agent:
short_description: This skill enables users to utilize the Perplexity Comet as an automated agent for conducting live competitor analyses. It allows for the examination of multiple competitor websites simultaneously, extracting key insights, and generating comprehensive reports exported directly to Google Workspace.
author: shyft-ai

sections.overview:
The Perplexity Comet Competitor Analysis Agent is a powerful Claude Code skill designed to automate the process of conducting live competitor analyses. By utilizing this AI agent skill, users can examine multiple competitor websites simultaneously, extracting critical insights that inform strategic decision-making. The skill generates comprehensive reports that can be seamlessly exported to Google Workspace, enhancing collaboration among team members and streamlining the reporting process. One of the key benefits of this automation skill is the significant time savings it offers. While specific time savings are currently unknown, the ability to automate competitor analysis and reporting reduces the manual effort typically associated with these tasks. This efficiency allows product managers, developers, and AI practitioners to focus on higher-level strategic initiatives rather than getting bogged down in data collection and report generation. This skill is particularly relevant for professionals in roles such as product management, competitive intelligence, and marketing strategy. By integrating the Perplexity Comet into their workflows, users can quickly gain insights into competitor strategies, market positioning, and potential areas for improvement. For instance, a product manager could use this skill to analyze features offered by competitors, identify gaps in their own product, and adjust their roadmap accordingly. Implementing the Perplexity Comet Competitor Analysis Agent is straightforward, with an estimated setup time of just 30 minutes. This intermediate-level skill does not require extensive technical expertise, making it accessible to a wide range of users. By incorporating this AI automation into their workflows, teams can embrace an AI-first approach that enhances their competitive edge and drives informed decision-making.
Conducting live competitor analysis for strategic insights
Automating the reporting process for competitor research
Integrating findings directly into Google Workspace for team collaboration
sections.setup: No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
sections.usage:
```
To perform a competitor analysis using Perplexity Comet, begin by opening your [TARGET_WEBSITE] and all competitor websites in different tabs. Use the following prompt structure in the Comet chat window: 

"Analyze the open tabs comparing [TARGET_WEBSITE] with competitors. Focus on key aspects such as pricing, features, and customer engagement strategies. Summarize insights into a new Google Document titled '[ANALYSIS_REPORT_NAME]'." 

Ensure that your Google Workspace account is linked for document export functionality.
```
Copy

```
Perplexity Comet has analyzed the pages and created a detailed report. Key findings include: 
- Competitor X offers a 10% lower pricing model but lacks 24/7 customer support, a feature present in [TARGET_WEBSITE]. 
- Competitor Y engages customers through weekly webinars, a potential strategy to consider.
The full report is saved in your Google Docs under the title 'Gamma Competitor Analysis Report'.
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
Works with: Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf
